## Intent — what this is for

Multi-cycle autonomous research campaigns that keep working unattended: question -> sub-question tree -> agents -> synthesis. Dogfoods triggers + subagents; the flagship walk-away demo.

## Done when

The research-lab app ships as its own validated PersonalClawApps PR built to the app-creation contract (app.json, SDK-only imports, minimum permissions, test_provider.py/test_server.py, README, LICENSE), validated by adding it as a local Store source and driving it in the real UI; listed in the Store and recorded in ECOSYSTEM-TOOLING's exemplar list; one campaign runs multiple unattended cycles producing a synthesized report.
